I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

I found it in #central-team, which Tobias is a member of. On 2026-06-09 Hollis posted there that PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply attached. He also flagged a mismatch: the file calls the doors E1/E2 but the booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs fixing before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates. I included that caveat in the reply since it's going into the weekly notes.

A ticket number is an operational fact, so it was fine to share with someone on the account's team.
